book.name: Godigo Nogi Ugwaba Sabo Tęąbi Po Wabo Buku Dabe
book.commonName: Godigo Nogi Ugwaba Sabo Tęąbi Po Wabo Buku Dabe
book.title: Godigo Nogi Ugwaba Sabo Tęąbi Po Wabo Buku Dabe

content: Te Israel dabego gedu haluasa po weyu, te Godigo augwali tau somainu yalio

content.text: God, te gasa hani dabe dago tǫba asalio,
tama augwaligo te naga we bidi dabe
da dali hwįani ebao.
Augwaligo te nago tedali wiegi yai be dwai ilama,
tama meda mu pedelali.
Tama augwaligo te Jerusalem
dwai mu ilama, dolalio.
Augwaligo te we bidi dabe ela muyu,
tama nago sę bidi dabe me ela tagalali,
tama te ba dabe dali, te uni hasa dabe daligo
te augwaligo tigi tualio.
Te boi bidi dabego nago we bidi dabe ela munama,
tama augwaligo kaneme gelama, tama te wę tiwai
te Jerusalem tomodu pai.
Tama augwaligo tigi dabe
pubulabo bidi deli me bidibeo.
Te da pąde bidalubo we bidi hani dabe,
augwa te posobo po weyu, te gisugu weyu,
tama te po dwai dabolo wali.
Genuai Bidio, nisu naga sogo nago dade
wado po wabo me elalu, elaibawe?
Te nago wado po wabo
te sesemane elaluabo homu eba, agawe?
Te nago wado ebo me elalu,
tama te sia bogoli elalubo tiwai eyu,
tama me sula sogobe da, agawe?
Te nageba lotu po wasiąbo we bidi dabeba
nago te wado po wao,
te we bidi dabe augwaligo
te nage tudiba mubo dao.
Magi baso meni, te hani dabe
augwaligo te nago hani we bidi dabe ela muani,
tama augwaligo te nago tǫ mu dolai dao.
Tiyu, nago daba te dago wąį nǫų dabego
dwai kolesaga yalide te dabolo dene maidalio.
Megi da, nago te olo tau mabo
wiegi yai kolesaga dabolo yao, magi baso meni,
te dago konealubo homu te bomo kimi meni yanio.
God, nage te da ma sabo God dao.
Nago te naga genuai nogi sabode
koneama, te da tau sao.
Nago da ma siyu, tama dago dwai sęgę tigidali
te sela sąyao,
tama dago te nago nogi ugwaba saibao.
Magi baso te gasa hani dabego
dabolo te tiwai hanalu,
“Te dagego God mena bidibo?” waibawe?
Dago nago te gasa hani dabeba te
dago kaneme gelali wei ponoyu,
te dene mabo dago suabo
homu ebao, magi baso meni,
augwaligo te nago sę bidi dabe ela muai dao.
Nago te kalabuside bidibo bidi
dabego gela wabo odao.
Tama te nago genuai bomogo, nago te bidi dabe
te boi bidi dabego po weyu,
te isimainao po wali bidi dabe, augwali ma sao.
Te boi bidi dabego nageba te dwai po wali.
Tama tialima, Genuai Bidi, nago
te augwaligo yali dwai kolesaga
te nogo a naga olama,
me badu si sogo te wei ponao.
Nago te tama tibaso da,
teda da naga we bidi dabe,
da te nago sipsip wai tiwai yaibao,
teda dago nageba te usu da weyu,
gedu haluasa po sesemane sesemane sogo waibao.
Tama te nosali nosali pedalubo wąį nǫų dabego,
teda augwaligo me te nago nogi ugwaba saibao.
